home.urgentFallback: There isn't a dedicated number for this. Call 112 if it's urgent, or 119 if someone needs rescue.

situationTips.emergency: For a life-threatening emergency, call 119 first. For suicide prevention counseling, call 109.
situationTips.car: For injuries, call 119. For expressway towing guidance, call 1588-2504 and confirm eligibility and limits.
situationTips.crime: End suspected phishing calls. Contact 1394 for advice or reporting; for immediate crime, call 112.
situationTips.home: For government inquiry guidance, call 110. For power faults, call 123; mobile callers need the area code.
situationTips.abroad: For overseas consular safety assistance, call +82-2-3210-0404.
situationTips.legal: For legal counseling, call 132; debt adjustment, 1600-5500; inclusive finance, 1397. Calling fees may apply.
